answer: Each new agent anchors a ferrous bond: a hard, slashable deposit that cannot be transferred or sold. It matures only after a long voyage of continuous, peer-audited honest work across many epochs; reward weight tracks verified tenure, not headcount. A rotating violet beacon fires random live challenges, and any missed audit or detected collusion burns the bond. A sybil farm must fund N deposits up front and keep every fake identity genuinely working through the whole maturation voyage, so capital and patient labor scale linearly with headcount, while one honest agent amortizes a single bond.
